ChildProfile.title: ChildProfile
ChildProfile.description: Stores a child learner's profile, preferences, parental PIN, stars, scores, and unlocked badges.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID owning this profile.

childName.description: Display name of the child explorer (1-40 chars).

ageGroup.description: Selected age bracket for adaptive difficulty.

languageCode.description: Multilingual UI and classroom learning language code (default 'id').

darkMode.description: Whether eye-friendly dark mode is active.

parentPin.description: 4-digit PIN protecting the parental progress dashboard.

totalStars.description: Cumulative stars earned across completed levels.

completedLevelsCount.description: Total number of mini-game levels completed.

logicScore.description: Cumulative logic and pattern mastery points.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

GameSessionRecord.title: GameSessionRecord
GameSessionRecord.description: Stores an individual completed mini-game level session for parental progress tracking.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID owning this session record.

gameType.description: Identifier of the educational mini-game played.

ageGroup.description: Age difficulty bracket played during this session.

correctAnswers.description: Number of correct answers in the session.

totalQuestions.description: Total number of questions in the session.

durationSeconds.description: Time spent completing the session in seconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was recorded (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user child learner profile and cumulative reward state.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Per-user completed educational mini-game sessions for parental analytics.
